description: This file implements the core logic for executing recorded user actions in Playwright's recorder, including navigation, clicking, filling forms, assertions, and other interactions, utilizing progress tracking and frame utilities.

methods.name: performAction
methods.description: Executes a user action in the context of given page aliases, handling different action types asynchronously.

methods.name: performActionImpl
methods.description: Internal implementation that performs specific actions like navigate, click, fill, and assertions based on action name.

methods.name: toClickOptions
methods.description: Converts a click action into mouse click options, including button, modifiers, click count, and position.
